mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE decreases significantly and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand, which can boost economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it indicates a weak labor market with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: weak labor market with accommodative policy
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 8% and FEDFUNDS < 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the cases.
